verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a browser-automation library and cloud service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no mention of telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. SOC 2/HIPAA compliance claims are a different privacy posture and do not show user-controllable telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
